source.check: candidates, votes, the number of electors on the register and the result read from the photographed page of the register (owner's PRONI photographs, transcribed 11 Nov 2026); names as the register writes them, surname first; the register gives no party labels

note: By-election of a councillor for Windsor Ward, 26 February 1937, to fill a casual vacancy. The register records the member as elected but gives no votes and does not say whether there was a poll. Register remarks: vice Councillor Francis James Holland (resigned Oct 1936).
cause: vice Councillor Francis James Holland (resigned Oct 1936)
